A personal anime log.

```{=html}
<style>
  .al-wrap {
    --al-accent: #2e51a2;
    --al-accent-soft: #e8eefc;
    --al-muted: #6b7280;
    --al-line: #e6e8eb;
    --al-bg: #f7f8fa;
    --al-card: #fff;
    color: #1f2937;
    margin-top: .5rem;
  }
  .al-toolbar {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: .55rem;
    align-items: center;
    margin-bottom: .9rem;
  }
  .al-search, .al-select {
    border: 1px solid var(--al-line);
    border-radius: 10px;
    padding: .48rem .75rem;
    font-size: .92rem;
    background: #fff;
    color: inherit;
  }
  .al-search { flex: 1 1 220px; min-width: 180px; }
  .al-select { flex: 0 1 180px; min-width: 140px; }
  .al-search:focus, .al-select:focus {
    outline: 2px solid rgba(46,81,162,.28);
    border-color: var(--al-accent);
  }
  .al-count {
    color: var(--al-muted);
    font-size: .85rem;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }
  .al-stats {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: .5rem 1rem;
    color: var(--al-muted);
    font-size: .85rem;
    margin: 0 0 1rem;
  }
  .al-stats strong { color: #1f2937; font-weight: 650; }
  .al-list {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: .65rem;
  }
  .al-row {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 64px 1fr auto;
    gap: .85rem;
    align-items: center;
    padding: .65rem .7rem;
    border: 1px solid var(--al-line);
    border-radius: 12px;
    background: var(--al-card);
    text-decoration: none !important;
    color: inherit !important;
    transition: border-color .12s ease, box-shadow .12s ease;
  }
  .al-row:hover {
    border-color: #c9d4ef;
    box-shadow: 0 2px 10px rgba(46,81,162,.08);
  }
  .al-cover {
    width: 64px;
    height: 90px;
    object-fit: cover;
    border-radius: 8px;
    background: var(--al-bg);
    display: block;
  }
  .al-cover-fallback {
    width: 64px;
    height: 90px;
    border-radius: 8px;
    background: linear-gradient(160deg, #dbe4f8, #f3f4f6);
  }
  .al-title {
    font-weight: 700;
    font-size: 1rem;
    line-height: 1.25;
    margin: 0 0 .2rem;
  }
  .al-native, .al-chinese {
    color: var(--al-muted);
    font-size: .8rem;
    margin: 0 0 .2rem;
  }
  .al-chinese { color: #4b5563; }
  .al-sub {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: .35rem .55rem;
    font-size: .8rem;
    color: var(--al-muted);
  }
  .al-chip {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: .25rem;
    background: var(--al-bg);
    border-radius: 999px;
    padding: .12rem .5rem;
  }
  .al-chip[data-status="watching"] { background: #e7f7ed; color: #157347; }
  .al-chip[data-status="completed"] { background: var(--al-accent-soft); color: var(--al-accent); }
  .al-chip[data-status="on_hold"] { background: #fff4e5; color: #9a5b00; }
  .al-chip[data-status="dropped"] { background: #fde8e8; color: #b42318; }
  .al-chip[data-status="plan_to_watch"] { background: #eef1f5; color: #4b5563; }
  .al-side {
    text-align: right;
    min-width: 4.5rem;
  }
  .al-score {
    font-size: 1.35rem;
    font-weight: 750;
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
    color: var(--al-accent);
    line-height: 1;
  }
  .al-score.is-empty { color: #c4c9d1; font-size: 1.1rem; }
  .al-empty {
    color: var(--al-muted);
    padding: 1.5rem .2rem;
  }
  @media (max-width: 640px) {
    .al-row { grid-template-columns: 56px 1fr; }
    .al-side {
      grid-column: 2;
      text-align: left;
      display: flex;
      gap: .75rem;
      align-items: baseline;
      min-width: 0;
    }
    .al-cover, .al-cover-fallback { width: 56px; height: 78px; }
  }
</style>

<div class="al-wrap" id="al-root">
  <div class="al-stats" id="al-stats"></div>
  <div class="al-toolbar">
    <input class="al-search" id="al-search" type="search" placeholder="Filter by title / 中文…" autocomplete="off" />
    <select class="al-select" id="al-status" aria-label="Filter by status">
      <option value="">All statuses</option>
      <option value="watching">Watching</option>
      <option value="completed">Completed</option>
      <option value="on_hold">On Hold</option>
      <option value="dropped">Dropped</option>
      <option value="plan_to_watch">Plan to Watch</option>
    </select>
    <select class="al-select" id="al-sort" aria-label="Sort">
      <option value="score" selected>Score</option>
      <option value="title">Title A–Z</option>
    </select>
    <span class="al-count" id="al-count"></span>
  </div>
  <div class="al-list" id="al-list"></div>
  <p class="al-empty" id="al-empty" hidden>No matching series.</p>
</div>

<script>
(async () => {
  const STATUS_LABEL = {
    watching: "Watching",
    completed: "Completed",
    on_hold: "On Hold",
    dropped: "Dropped",
    plan_to_watch: "Plan to Watch",
  };

  // Same score → Watching, Completed, On Hold, Plan to Watch, Dropped
  const STATUS_RANK = {
    watching: 0,
    completed: 1,
    on_hold: 2,
    plan_to_watch: 3,
    dropped: 4,
  };

  const root = document.getElementById("al-root");
  const listEl = document.getElementById("al-list");
  const emptyEl = document.getElementById("al-empty");
  const countEl = document.getElementById("al-count");
  const statsEl = document.getElementById("al-stats");
  const searchEl = document.getElementById("al-search");
  const statusEl = document.getElementById("al-status");
  const sortEl = document.getElementById("al-sort");

  let series = [];

  const fmtScore = (score) =>
    score == null || score === "" ? "—" : Number(score).toFixed(Number(score) % 1 ? 1 : 0);

  const renderStats = (items) => {
    const counts = {};
    Object.keys(STATUS_LABEL).forEach((k) => (counts[k] = 0));
    let scored = 0;
    let scoreSum = 0;
    items.forEach((item) => {
      counts[item.status] = (counts[item.status] || 0) + 1;
      if (item.score != null && item.score !== "") {
        scored += 1;
        scoreSum += Number(item.score);
      }
    });
    const mean = scored ? (scoreSum / scored).toFixed(2) : "—";
    statsEl.innerHTML = `
      <span><strong>${items.length}</strong> series</span>
      <span>Watching <strong>${counts.watching || 0}</strong></span>
      <span>Completed <strong>${counts.completed || 0}</strong></span>
      <span>Mean score <strong>${mean}</strong></span>
    `;
  };

  const render = () => {
    const needle = searchEl.value.trim().toLowerCase();
    const status = statusEl.value;
    const sort = sortEl.value;

    let filtered = series.filter((item) => {
      const statusOk = !status || item.status === status;
      const hay = `${item.title || ""} ${item.title_native || ""} ${item.title_chinese || ""}`.toLowerCase();
      const searchOk = !needle || hay.includes(needle);
      return statusOk && searchOk;
    });

    const byStatusThenTitle = (a, b) => {
      const ar = STATUS_RANK[a.status] ?? 99;
      const br = STATUS_RANK[b.status] ?? 99;
      return ar - br || (a.title || "").localeCompare(b.title || "", undefined, { sensitivity: "base" });
    };

    filtered = filtered.slice().sort((a, b) => {
      if (sort === "title") {
        return (a.title || "").localeCompare(b.title || "", undefined, { sensitivity: "base" })
          || byStatusThenTitle(a, b);
      }
      // Default: rating high → low; unrated last; same rating → status
      const as = a.score == null || a.score === "" ? -1 : Number(a.score);
      const bs = b.score == null || b.score === "" ? -1 : Number(b.score);
      return bs - as || byStatusThenTitle(a, b);
    });

    listEl.replaceChildren();
    filtered.forEach((item) => {
      const a = document.createElement("a");
      a.className = "al-row";
      a.href = item.mal_url || item.url || "#";
      a.target = "_blank";
      a.rel = "noopener";

      if (item.cover) {
        const img = document.createElement("img");
        img.className = "al-cover";
        img.src = item.cover;
        img.alt = "";
        img.loading = "lazy";
        a.appendChild(img);
      } else {
        const ph = document.createElement("div");
        ph.className = "al-cover-fallback";
        a.appendChild(ph);
      }

      const mid = document.createElement("div");
      const title = document.createElement("h3");
      title.className = "al-title";
      title.textContent = item.title || "Untitled";
      mid.appendChild(title);
      if (item.title_chinese) {
        const chinese = document.createElement("p");
        chinese.className = "al-chinese";
        chinese.textContent = item.title_chinese;
        mid.appendChild(chinese);
      }
      if (item.title_native) {
        const native = document.createElement("p");
        native.className = "al-native";
        native.textContent = item.title_native;
        mid.appendChild(native);
      }
      const sub = document.createElement("div");
      sub.className = "al-sub";
      const statusChip = document.createElement("span");
      statusChip.className = "al-chip";
      statusChip.dataset.status = item.status || "plan_to_watch";
      statusChip.textContent = STATUS_LABEL[item.status] || item.status || "Plan to Watch";
      sub.appendChild(statusChip);
      mid.appendChild(sub);
      if (item.notes) {
        const notes = document.createElement("p");
        notes.className = "al-native";
        notes.style.marginTop = ".35rem";
        notes.textContent = item.notes;
        mid.appendChild(notes);
      }
      a.appendChild(mid);

      const side = document.createElement("div");
      side.className = "al-side";
      const score = document.createElement("div");
      score.className = "al-score" + (item.score == null || item.score === "" ? " is-empty" : "");
      score.textContent = fmtScore(item.score);
      side.appendChild(score);
      a.appendChild(side);

      listEl.appendChild(a);
    });

    emptyEl.hidden = filtered.length > 0;
    countEl.textContent = `${filtered.length} / ${series.length}`;
  };

  try {
    const res = await fetch("assets/anime/list.json", { cache: "no-store" });
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status}`);
    const data = await res.json();
    series = Array.isArray(data) ? data : (data.series || []);
    renderStats(series);
    render();
    searchEl.addEventListener("input", render);
    statusEl.addEventListener("change", render);
    sortEl.addEventListener("change", render);
  } catch (err) {
    root.innerHTML = `<p class="al-empty">Could not load anime list.</p>`;
    console.error(err);
  }
})();
</script>
```
